# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

Aggregate
:   a collection-valued type: `SET` (unordered, no duplicates), `BAG` (unordered, duplicates allowed), `LIST` (ordered) or `ARRAY` (ordered, fixed bounds).
    The file writes all four as a parenthesised list.

AIM
:   Application Interpreted Model: an AP's data model expressed in integrated-resource entities.
    What the file contains.

Anchor
:   (edition 3) a stable public name for an instance, for reference from other files.

AP
:   Application Protocol: a scoped data model for a domain.
    AP203, AP214, AP242.

ARM
:   Application Reference Model: an AP's data model in domain vocabulary.
    What the committee designed.

Attribute
:   one named slot of an entity, declared in the schema.
    A record supplies one parameter per attribute, in declaration order; the file writes the values and never the names.

B-rep
:   boundary representation: a solid described by its bounding faces, edges and vertices.

Complex entity instance
:   a record with several entity types (external mapping), for an object whose combination of subtypes has no single name.

Conformance class
:   a named subset of an AP that an implementation can claim to support.

Datum
:   a theoretically exact reference plane, axis or point derived from a real feature.

Defined type
:   a name given to a base type so the schema can say what a value is *for*, as in `TYPE label = STRING;`.
    The file does not distinguish them; a string is a string.

Derived attribute
:   one whose value is computed from others rather than stored.
    An attribute a subtype redeclares as derived keeps its slot and is written `*`; one the entity declares itself takes no slot and is not written at all.

Entity
:   a type declared in the schema, with an ordered list of attributes.
    One record in the data section is one instance, of one entity or — in the complex form — of several at once.

Enumeration
:   a type whose values are a fixed set of names, written in the file between full stops: `.MILLI.`, `.METRE.`.
    `BOOLEAN` and `LOGICAL` are written the same way but are base types, not enumerations.

EXPRESS
:   the schema language of ISO 10303 (Part 11).

External mapping
:   the parenthesised multi-type form of a record.
    See complex entity instance.

Feature control frame
:   the boxed statement of one geometric tolerance on a drawing or model.

GD&T
:   geometric dimensioning and tolerancing; the language of tolerances and datums.

Instance name
:   the `#n` identifier of a record; file-local.

Integrated resources
:   the shared library of entity definitions (Parts 41–61 and 101–112) from which every AP is built.

Internal mapping
:   the ordinary one-type record form with all inherited attributes flattened.

Knot vector
:   the parameter breakpoints of a B-spline; stored as distinct values plus multiplicities.

Long form
:   an AP schema flattened into a single file (`_MIM_LF`).

NAUO
:   `NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE`: one occurrence of a child in a parent.

NURBS
:   non-uniform rational B-spline; the free-form curve and surface type.

Part 21
:   ISO 10303-21, the clear-text file format.
    "A STEP file."

Pcurve
:   a curve in the parameter space of a surface; the 2D image of an edge on a face.

PMI
:   product manufacturing information: tolerances, datums, dimensions, notes.

Representation
:   a set of representation items in a context; the Part 43 container for geometry and properties.

Schema
:   a collection of EXPRESS declarations naming every entity a conforming file may use, and the constraints on them.
    A file names the schema it claims to follow in `FILE_SCHEMA`.

Seam
:   an edge along which a periodic surface is cut, traversed twice by one loop.

SELECT
:   a type that admits any one of several alternatives.
    A value is wrapped in the name of the alternative chosen when that alternative is not an entity, as in `LENGTH_MEASURE(1.E-07)`.

Semantic PMI
:   PMI as data; contrast graphical PMI, PMI as drawn symbols.

Shape aspect
:   a named region of a shape that a tolerance or property can refer to.

Subtype, supertype
:   an entity that extends another, and the one it extends.
    A record carries the supertypes' attributes first, from the root of the chain down; see internal mapping.

Uncertainty
:   the writing kernel's coincidence tolerance, carried in the representation context.

Validation property
:   volume, area, centroid or count written by the exporter so the importer can check the transfer.
